parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description: The edition. Valid values: BASIC and STANDARD. Default value: STANDARD.

parameters.name: PlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup rule.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **ECS\_FILE**: Backs up ECS files.

- **OSS**: Backs up Alibaba Cloud OSS.

- **NAS**: Backs up Alibaba Cloud NAS.

parameters.name: VaultId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup vault.
